title: 第14章 密谈第15章 黑市

第十四章 密谈
之后的几天，林立忙得不可开交。
虽然葛瑞安已经安排了凯文帮他跑腿，但很多事还是必须由他亲自去办，比如去图书馆抄录咒语。
望着眼前堆积如山的魔法书，林立才真正明白，为什么安度因那老家伙总是说，魔法的世界没有尽头的……这么多书，光是看目录就够看好几年的了，更别说研究上面记载的法术。
林立已经在图书馆里坐了两天了，魔法书上记录的咒语大概有二三十条，这都是他认为有用的魔法。
他选择魔法的标准，往往只有两个要求，第一是咒语长度要短，第二是元素结构要简单。
换了大多数魔法师来，恐怕都要对这两个标准嗤之以鼻。
相同等级的魔法中，咒语越长结构越复杂，威力自然也就越大，既然都消耗相同的魔力，谁不愿意选威力大的？这就跟打麻将一样，一把好牌拿起来，谁不愿意做做清一色什么的？
但对林立来说，威力大小其实并不重要。
“不求最好，但求最多！”在庞大精神力的支持下，林立从来就不会担心自己魔力枯竭，更不用担心精神力无法负荷。
反倒是长时间的咒语吟唱，更容易让他陷入危险当中，既然无法在短时间内解决咒语吟唱速度的问题，林立干脆专门选些简单的魔法来学，反正魔力不会枯竭，一个不行就多用几个，几十个魔法砸下来，还有什么东西是砸不倒的？
这中间葛瑞安抽空过来关心了一下，见识过林立那诡异的挑选标准之后，胖老头不由一阵毛骨悚然……
看看那二三十条咒语都有些什么。
精神控制，巫师之眼，奥术飞弹，虚弱无力，肢体麻痹，魔力防护，魔力增幅，丧心病狂，心志狂乱，石化皮肤……
除了奥术飞弹等寥寥几个纯攻击性法术之外，其他无一不是阴险毒辣的控制法术。
葛瑞安没说什么，摸了摸鼻子就溜出去了，出门就悄悄嘀咕到，这小子真是安度因的弟子？我怎么不知道安度因还有这些爱好……
抄录魔法是件很麻烦的事，特别是象林立这种半吊子，语言基础太差，除了通用语之外，其他语言对他来说就是标准的天书，于是他不得不一边翻看各种语言入门，一边将那一条条咒语抄进魔法书里。
这二三十条咒语，就花了他差不多两天的时间。
等他从书堆中抬起头来，已经是第二天傍晚的时候了。
林立伸了个长长的懒腰，将桌上的书本一一放回原位，正打算离开图书馆的时候，却看见凯文走了进来。

“费雷，你抄完咒语了？”凯文进门时，正看见林立在收拾书本：“正好，葛瑞安会长让我跟你说一声，他在一楼大厅等你，让你抄完咒语之后就去找他，他好象有什么事情要跟你说。”
“什么事情这么急？”林立有些愕然，胖老头上午才来过图书馆，有什么事怎么当时不说？
“他没跟我说什么事，就光是叫你去一趟。”
“哦……麻烦你了。”
林立出了图书馆之后，很快就在一楼大厅找到了葛瑞安。
胖老头今天心情不错，正在指点两个年轻法师。
“蠢货！你们还敢再蠢一点吗？这么简单的元素排列都无法完成，你们一天到晚究竟都往脑子里装了些什么东西？”当然——他的指点方式，一向是比较特别的。
两个年轻法师被训得满头是包，可偏偏还不敢为自己辩解，只能一脸委屈的低着头，老老实实的听胖老头训话，看到林立下来的时候，两人就好象找到了救星似的，赶紧朝林立投来求助的目光。
“葛瑞安会长，听说您正在找我？”见这两个家伙实在可怜，林立摇了摇头，还是先出声跟胖老头打了个招呼。
“费雷你来了。”这确实替两个法师解了围，见林立过来，葛瑞安也没空再继续训他们了：“来来来，我跟你谈点事情。”
“你们两个……”走到半路，葛瑞安似乎又想起来了，不过犹豫了一下，还是有些无奈冲那两个倒霉法师挥了挥手：“算了，赶紧有多远给我死多远……”
葛瑞安也不知道有什么事，一路上都显得很谨慎，为了不被人打扰，还特意带着林立进了公会会客室。
如果非要在加洛斯魔法公会里找出一个最安全的地方，那无疑就是这间公会会客室里，门外七枚巫师之眼，全方位的监视着周围一举一动，紧闭的房门背后，一道魔法探测立场魔纹，正散发出淡淡的魔法波动，在这道魔纹的影响下，任何魔法窥视都瞒不过葛瑞安的耳目。
林立一看葛瑞安如此郑重，也知道肯定不是小事，拉了张椅子过来坐下，静静等他开口。
今天的葛瑞安似乎特别谨慎，就算是身处公会最安全的会客室里，他还是不太放心，又放了一个生命感知魔法，确定周围再无其他活人之后，这才压低声问道：“告诉我，你是什么时候惹上梅林家族的？”
“梅林家族？”这已经是林立第二次听葛瑞安提起这个名字了，上一次是在前几天进行等级认证的时候，他记得当时胖老头好象发了很大的火，扬言要将这个梅林家族如何如何来的……
正有些疑惑的时候，林立忽然想起一个人来。
克伦威尔！没错，就是克伦威尔！
刚到加洛斯城的那样，这位热心魔法师似乎曾经提到过相同的名字，如果林立没记错的话，他的原话应该是——“如果有什么要帮忙的话尽管开口，我们梅林家族在加洛斯魔法公会还算是能说上话。”
“您是说……克伦威尔？”

“没错，就是他。”葛瑞安点了点头：“还记得你刚来那天吗？
“记得。”
“那天你刚跟凯文去办手续，克伦威尔的人就找上门来了，哼哼，这蠢货居然要求我把你踢出公会，真是瞎了他的狗眼！”
“当时我还没空理他，只是让科林去带了个话，警告这蠢货最好别打你的主意。”说到这里，葛瑞安闷哼一声：“想不到这白痴居然这么不知进退，今天下午又派了人来，这一次他甚至还敢威胁起我来了，说要是不照他意思办的话，他将说服家族终止与公会的生意合作。”
林立什么也没说，只是笑咪咪的望着葛瑞安。
葛瑞安执掌加洛斯魔法公会数十年，又岂是一般的人物，要是连个克伦威尔都对付不了，怕是早被人吞得连骨头都不剩了。
他既然主动提起了这件事，那心里面肯定早就有了打算。
在林立看来，胖老头那愤怒的神态，无非只是一种态度，一种支持自己的态度。
所以林立什么也不说，就等着葛瑞安开口。
“哼！真是瞎了他的狗眼，也不看看自己威胁的是谁”葛瑞安果然义愤填膺，怒不可遏的宣布：“加洛斯魔法公会这几年虽然维持得很艰难，却还没落魄到受人威胁的地步！既然是我把你弄进公会的，我就必须对你负责，谁要是想动你，就得先问问我葛瑞安同不同意！”
“谢谢会长！”
content_en:
Chapter 14 Secret Talk
In the next few days, Lin Li was very busy.
Although Greg had arranged for Kevin to run errands for him, he still had to do many things himself, such as going to the library to copy spells.
Looking at the mountains of magic books in front of him, Lin Li truly understood why that old guy Anduin always said that the world of magic has no end... With so many books, just looking at the catalog would take several years, let alone studying the spells recorded in them.
Lin Li has been sitting in the library for two days. There are about twenty or thirty spells recorded in the magic book. These are all magics that he thinks are useful.
His criteria for selecting magic often have only two requirements. The first is that the length of the spell must be short, and the second is that the elemental structure must be simple.
Most magicians would probably sneer at these two standards.
Among magics of the same level, the longer the spell and the more complex the structure, the more powerful it will naturally be. Since they all consume the same magic power, who wouldn't want to choose the more powerful one? It's just like playing mahjong. If you pick up a good set of cards, who wouldn't want to play all the cards?
But to Lin Li, the power was not important.
"Don't ask for the best, but ask for the most!" With the support of his huge mental power, Lin Li never worries about running out of his magic power, let alone the fact that his mental power cannot bear the load.
On the contrary, long-term spell chanting is more likely to put him in danger. Since the problem of spell chanting speed cannot be solved in a short time, Lin Li simply chooses some simple magic to learn. Anyway, the magic power will not be exhausted. If one doesn't work, just use a few more. If dozens of magic are smashed down, what else can't be smashed?
In the meantime, Greg took the time to come over and pay attention. After seeing Lin Li's weird selection criteria, the fat old man couldn't help but feel creepy...
Take a look at what those twenty or thirty mantras contain.
Mind control, wizard's eye, arcane missiles, weakness, paralysis, magic protection, magic amplification, madness, madness, petrified skin...
Except for a few purely offensive spells such as arcane missiles, the others are all insidious and vicious control spells.
Grean didn't say anything, just touched his nose and slipped out. As he walked out, he whispered quietly, is this kid really a disciple of Anduin? Why didn't I know Anduin had these hobbies...
Copying magic is a very troublesome task, especially for a dabbler like Lin Li who has a poor foundation in language. Except for Common Language, other languages ​​are standard bibles for him, so he had to read through various language introductions while copying the spells into the magic book.
These twenty or thirty spells took him almost two days.
By the time he looked up from the pile of books, it was already the evening of the next day.
Lin Li stretched out and put the books on the table back to their original places one by one. When he was about to leave the library, he saw Kevin walking in.
"Feire, have you finished copying the spell?" When Kevin came in, he saw Lin Li packing up his books: "Just in time, President Grean asked me to tell you that he is waiting for you in the lobby on the first floor and asked you to go find him after you finish copying the spell. He seems to have something to tell you."
"What's so urgent?" Lin Li was a little stunned. The fat old man had just been to the library in the morning. Why didn't he say something about something?
"He didn't say anything to me, he just asked you to go there."
"Oh...I'm sorry to trouble you."
After Lin Li left the library, he quickly found Greg in the lobby on the first floor.
The fat old man was in a good mood today and was giving guidance to two young mages.
"Idiot! Do you dare to be more stupid? Such a simple arrangement of elements cannot be completed. What on earth have you put in your mind all day long?" Of course - his way of giving directions has always been quite special.
The two young mages were trained so hard that they still didn'tThose who dared to defend themselves could only lower their heads with aggrieved expressions and listen to the fat old man's instructions. When they saw Lin Li coming down, the two of them seemed to have found a savior and quickly looked at Lin Li for help.
"President Greg, I heard that you are looking for me?" Seeing how pitiful these two guys were, Lin Li shook his head and said hello to the fat old man first.
"Feire, you're here." This indeed relieved the situation for the two mages. Seeing Lin Li coming over, Grean had no time to continue lecturing them: "Come on, come on, let me talk to you about something."
"You two..." Halfway through, Grean seemed to remember it again, but after a moment of hesitation, he still waved helplessly at the two unlucky mages: "Forget it, hurry up and die as far as you can..."
Greg didn't know what was going on, so he seemed very cautious along the way. In order not to be disturbed, he even led Lin Li into the guild's reception room.
If you had to find the safest place in the Garros Magic Guild, it would undoubtedly be in the guild's reception room. The seven wizard eyes outside the door monitor every move in all directions. Behind the closed door, a magic detection stance pattern is emitting faint magic fluctuations. Under the influence of this magic pattern, no magical prying eyes can hide from Greg's eyes and ears.
Lin Li saw that Greg was so serious and knew it was definitely not a trivial matter. He pulled up a chair and sat down, waiting quietly for him to speak.
Today, Greg seemed to be particularly cautious. Even though he was in the safest reception room in the guild, he still felt uneasy. He cast another life-sensing magic and made sure that there were no other living people around. Then he asked in a low voice: "Tell me, when did you get into trouble with the Merlin family?"
"The Merlin family?" This was the second time Lin Li heard Greg Ruian mention this name. The last time was during the level certification a few days ago. He remembered that the fat old man seemed to be very angry at that time, threatening to tell how this Merlin family came to be...
Just when he was a little confused, Lin Li suddenly remembered someone.
Cromwell! That’s right, it’s Cromwell!
As he had just arrived in Garros City, this enthusiastic magician seemed to have mentioned the same name. If Lin Li remembered correctly, his original words should have been - "If you need any help, just ask. Our Merlin family can still speak in the Garros Magic Guild."
"You mean... Cromwell?"
"Yes, that's him." Grean nodded: "Do you still remember the day you first came here?
"Remember. "
"As soon as you and Kevin went to complete the formalities that day, Cromwell's people came to your door. Hum, this idiot actually asked me to kick you out of the guild. He was really blind! "
"I didn't have time to pay attention to him at that time, I just asked Colin to bring a message, warning this idiot that it's best not to take your idea. "At this point, Gregorian snorted: "I didn't expect this idiot to be so clueless. He sent someone here again this afternoon. This time he even dared to threaten me, saying that if I didn't do what he wanted, he would persuade the family to terminate the business cooperation with the guild. "
Lin Li said nothing, just looked at Greg with a smile.
Greg has been in charge of the Garros Magic Guild for decades, so how can he be an ordinary person? If he couldn't deal with Cromwell, he would have been devoured long ago without even the bones left.
Since he took the initiative to mention this matter, he must have had a plan in mind.
In Lin Li's opinion, the fat old man's angry look was nothing more than an attitude, an attitude to support himself.
So Lin Li didn't say anything, just waiting for Greg to speak.
"Hmph! He is really blind, and he does not see who he is threatening." Grean was indeed filled with righteous indignation, and angrily announced: "Although the Garros Magic Guild has been very difficult to maintain in the past few years, it is not in such a state that it is threatened by others.The point! Since I was the one who got you into the guild, I must be responsible for you. If anyone wants to touch you, they must first ask me if Gray agrees! "
"Thank you, President! "
